Title: Chromie Hotfix Patch #2
Subtitle: Hotfix 18.2.43170 (May 25, 2016), fixing a client shutdown issue along with bug fixes for Kerrigan and Rehgar.
Highlights: Hotfix 18.2.43170 (May 25, 2016), fixing a client shutdown issue along with bug fixes for Kerrigan and Rehgar.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could prevent the client from fully shutting down after exiting the game.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Kerrigan's Fury of the Swarm ability to display an incorrect value.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Casting Rewind will no longer reset the cooldown of Ghost Wolf (Z).

General: • Fixed an issue that could prevent the client from fully shutting down after exiting the game.
